mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE role='USER' AND status<>'DELETED') AS total_users, count(*) FILTER (WHERE role='USER' AND status='ACTIVE' AND temporary_password_expires_at IS NULL) AS active_users, count(*) FILTER (WHERE role='USER' AND status='ACTIVE' AND temporary_password_expires_at IS NOT NULL) AS pending_users, count(*) FILTER (WHERE role='USER' AND status='DISABLED') AS disabled_users, count(*) FILTER (WHERE role='USER' AND status='DELETION_PENDING') AS deletion_pending_users, (SELECT count(*) FROM user_session WHERE revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS active_sessions, max(last_active_at) FILTER (WHERE role='USER' AND status<>'DELETED') AS last_active_at, pg_database_size(current_database()) AS database_bytes FROM app_user
